title: BSC v2, Base v2, HyperEVM v2: collector cadence brought into line with the SEALED expected_sample_period_s (300 s)

disclosure.summary: The three sealed standards set protocol_constants.expected_sample_period_s = 300 and make a matured row INCOMPLETE below 90% of 'the expected ~5-minute samples'. Their collectors ran every 600 s and the resolver code expected 2016 samples per 14-day window (600 s). From 2026-09-29T17:05:00Z the collectors run every 300 s and the resolver expects 4032 samples (300 s), exactly as sealed. NO sealed text is changed by this disclosure.
disclosure.how_it_happened: The three boards were cloned from AVAX v2, whose collector does run every 300 s. The standard text kept AVAX's 300 s constant; the collector timers and resolver constant were set to 600 s. The same standards' outcome sentence describes sampling as 'one per ~10 minutes', so the sealed text is internally inconsistent; the numeric protocol constant (300 s) is the binding one and is what operations now follow.
disclosure.why_not_the_other_way: Resolving at 600 s would contradict the sealed constant: anyone re-grading from the sealed standard would count every window at ~50% coverage, i.e. INCOMPLETE, and the verdict INVALID. Changing the constant would be an amendment applied to cohorts already frozen under it. Sampling at the sealed rate needs neither.

timeline.collection_600s: bsc-v2 and base-v2 from 2026-09-28T17:30:00Z, hyperevm-v2 from 2026-09-29T11:30:00Z, through 2026-09-29T17:00:00Z
timeline.collection_300s_from: 2026-09-29T17:05:00Z (first 300 s run on all three: bsc 30/30, base 30/30, hyperevm 18/18 pools)

cohorts_frozen_before_the_switch.treatment: Graded unchanged under the sealed rule. Projections assume no further collector outage; any shortfall is reported by the resolver as it would be for any cohort.

disclosure.what_does_not_change: Every forecast field and model (entry sample <= 900 s old, bands, p, tiers, model_version), the outcome (ANY collector sample in the window outside the band), the 90% coverage floor and every verdict rule. Denser sampling can catch a brief excursion that 600 s sampling would miss; the outcome is defined on collector samples, and the sealed expected rate is 300 s.
disclosure.not_affected: AVAX v2 (always 300 s, as sealed), OP v2 (180 s, as sealed), SUI v2 (600 s, as sealed), Monad v2 (sealed at 600 s, matching its collector).
disclosure.immutability: Sealed before any window of the three boards has matured (the first matures 2026-10-13). Any further change is another dated disclosure.
